Tess (CS): Avalon flagged three onboarding pain points in today's call. Renewal review in ~5w — want to surface for product prioritization.
Diego (CS): Quick notes:
- Relevance: their search returns marketing pages after CSV ingest, not internal SOPs.
- Billing: they need to split support vs analytics usage per-route.
- Bulk import: long-running jobs error at ~40k rows with no clear retry.
Anya (PM): From product POV: relevance impacts adoption (P0), per-route billing is P1 (commercial ask), import robustness P2. We should triage relevance first.
Rex (ENG): Can we get a sanitized sample + request id? Also whether they used UI or API ingest.
Tess (CS): Sample they shared (sanitized):
```
{"text":"ECG device calibration checklist","model":"redwood-sim-1.0","metadata":{"customer":"avalon-health"}}
```
Request id example: avalon-req-2026-09-04-550. They used the API bulk endpoint for ingest.
billing-bot: Created ticket CS-6810 and linked ENG-2519.
Rex (ENG): I'll take the 48h triage to repro relevance locally (check model routing, tokenization, and vectorstore mapping). If needed I can prototype a narrower similarity threshold as a mitigation.
Anya (PM): Plan: 1) ENG triage (48h) owner Rex. 2) Product RFC for per-route billing (next sprint). 3) CS to collect 2 more samples and include in renewal risk memo.
Diego (CS): I'll gather two more sanitized examples today and add quotes to CS-6810.
Tess (CS): I'll set customer expectation: 48h triage update and a follow-up enablement call if mitigation helps.
Rex (ENG): Starting repro now; will post root cause or mitigation in 48h.
Anya (PM): If triage shows routing bug, we fast-track. If it's model selection, propose a config surface to pin model for CSV imports.
Tess (CS): Internal notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/avalon-onboard-09-2026 (internal). Keeping this thread open until ENG posts findings.
